name: Short-hold funding-fear scalp bounce (tight TP, 3-5d snapback)
rationale: A fast-turnover variant testing whether the funding+fear composite captures a SHORT, sharp snapback rather than a multi-week reversal. Arm a long when funding is soft (below ceiling) AND Fear&Greed is fearful, then exit fast on a TIGHT take-profit or a short time-stop — the bet is purely the immediate post-flush bounce. Both inputs BOUNDED/mean-reverting; funding ceiling straddles realized to bite (null carry). Because turnover is high, the tp/stop band is tight and the spec is restricted to the cheapest-to-trade names implicitly via min_liquidity; the Gate must net 10bps taker per leg. DISCONFIRMER: the SAME funding+fear entry with a LONG hold (max_hold 25-30d, wide TP) is in this cohort — if a true capitulation bounce exists it should persist beyond a few days, so if ONLY the tight-TP short-hold version is profitable, the apparent edge is a transient microstructure/noise artifact that 10bps fees should erase, not a durable reversal. If the short-hold turnover makes it fee-negative, that is an honest FAIL. Gate disposes.
catalyst: soft funding + fear, played for a fast 3-5 day snapback
